title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct final answer for the relative error in potential, approximately 1 x 10^-9.

title: Charge Distribution
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly identifies the charge distribution of the nucleus as uniform and ellipsoidal.

title: Potential Components
description: Important Criteria: The student distinguishes between the point charge potential and the quadrupole potential in their calculations.

title: Deformation Parameter
description: Important Criteria: The student accurately calculates the deformation parameter epsilon based on the given axis ratio.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Quadrupole Moment
description: Optional Criteria: The student correctly derives the expression for the electric quadrupole moment M.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to account for the factor of R^2 in the quadrupole moment calculation, leading to incorrect results.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes a sign mistake in the calculation of the relative error, affecting the final answer.
